name: Structure Ruleset

inheritance.rule: Ruleset composition, dependency closure, conflict, exclusion, cycle, resolution and validation semantics are inherited from DependencyRules.

purpose: Define Structure-domain recognition, progressive formalization, Event/Effect causality, dependency precision, evaluation results and projection boundaries over CCF 2.0 without changing CCF.

rules: Missing required information normally produces incomplete, not violated.
violated requires explicit canonical evidence that conflicts with a hard Ruleset requirement.
not_applicable means insufficient candidate evidence exists to apply the Ruleset.
Evaluation results are derived and MUST NOT rewrite canonical truth.

rulesets.role: Minimum permissive Structure interpretation of CCF.
requirements: Relationships may remain generic while meaning is unresolved.

rulesets.role: CanonicalWireframe formalization goal over the same CCF abstraction.
requirements: Machine-significant Properties use explicit Property Types and applicable external Rulesets.
Directed semantic connections are explicit Link Properties.
Unknown required semantics remain explicit gaps.
Causal semantics preserve explicit Event -> Effect -> target paths when those intermediate semantics are meaningful.
Canonical references resolve deterministically without semantic guessing.

constraints: Carries Structure-domain semantic contract facts without introducing new CCF primitives.
Data semantics are canonical and independent of rendering.
Function inputs and outputs use canonical references when modeled.
Function semantics do not arise from UI controls.
parent_ref is the dependency target and child_ref is the dependent.
The dependency target SHOULD be the narrowest known canonical identity.
Entity targets are used only when the dependency genuinely concerns the whole Entity.
A dependency MAY target a Property, including data, function, Event or another addressable Property.
No duplicate target_ref or dependency_type field is required when endpoint identity and canonical facts are sufficient.
Property targeting is preferred when the affected canonical subject is known more precisely.

rules: No reverse causal link is implied.
Event A -> Event B MUST NOT replace Event -> Effect -> target -> downstream Event when the intermediate path carries canonical meaning.
Event ownership or visual placement MUST NOT be inferred from link direction.
Visual Event controls are representations only.

progressive_formalization.rule: Nothing is blocked merely because a semantic contract is incomplete; incompleteness is exposed as derived evaluation data and actionable gaps.

projection_boundary.rule: Projection is representation, never canonical truth.
projection_boundary.aggregation_rule: Multiple canonical links of the same link type between the same projected subjects MAY be visually aggregated without deleting or merging canonical Link identities.
projection_boundary.event_exception: Event causal links are shown through causal route projection rather than generic structural-link rendering.

abstraction_model.role: Persistable and composable boundary containing CCF Entities.
abstraction_model.imports: Abstractions MAY import other Abstractions by reference. Import is composition, not copy; the imported Abstraction remains authoritative for its own canonical content.
abstraction_model.ruleset_boundary: Ruleset definitions remain external to Abstraction CCF.

required_checks: ruleset evaluation does not mutate canonical truth
dependency target uses canonical Link endpoint semantics
Event causal links satisfy endpoint-kind constraints
projection state does not become canonical semantics
unresolved semantics are not silently classified as invalid
